data.name: 剑箫行
data.detailed_description:
【 Overview 】
Jian Xiao Travel is a pixel-style action adventure game set in a fantasy novel. The original intention of the game design is that the player can understand the artistic conception of the novel during the play.

【 Main setting of the game 】
Game Settings include and are not limited to the following:
1, the cultivation speed of the immortal is related to the exercise method, spiritual stone, and environment;
2, the day and night combat environment is different;
3, release the spell in addition to the selected direction can also decide to inject spirit power, and then determine the damage value, and have a proficiency setting, the higher the proficiency, the higher the basic damage;
4, the special utility of special exercises (for example, the ninth Xiao Chengtian Formula can reduce the realm but the strength remains unchanged, and it can easily cross the border challenge after retraining nine times, which also comes from some Settings in the novel);
5, the spirit stone can be traded and can assist in healing, spiritual, cultivation, etc.;
6, the magic weapon can be injected into the spirit after the equipment to further enhance the strength, and some magic weapons have their own spells and gain effects;
7. Healing and cultivation may be interrupted;
8, when attacked, there will be a certain time to react, so as to avoid damage;
9, different parts of the injury has different effects;
10. You may meet special people on your way to practice.

data.short_description: JXX is an ARPG pixel style game based on a fantasy fantasy novel setting. You will play the role of a young man who cultivates, fights, breaks, and asks Dao under the guidance of his predecessors to solve his own mysteries and solve the world's woes in the rapid strength improvement.
